$about: Workstream 5 test fixture: an invented dossier (no real job text) in the old app's dossier text format, matching the source ids and quotes of tests/bms/fixtures/sample_job.json. images[].path is relative to this folder's test tmp copy.
text_lines: Everything controls-relevant in the bid documents. Every paragraph and row starts with its source id in square brackets (S1, S2 and so on); pictures are named I1, I2 and so on. Cite them.
[S16] Who does what (control wiring): “all control wiring by the controls contractor”
[S17] RTU-1 and RTU-2: the rooftop units shall run on their factory controls.
[S18] The exhaust fans shall start and stop on the BMS schedule.
[S19] When EF-1 runs, MD-1 shall open.
[S20] DH-1 and DH-2: the BMS shall modulate the duct heater to maintain discharge temperature.
[S21] The cabinet unit heaters shall cycle to maintain space temperature.
[S24] ROOFTOP UNIT SCHEDULE — M-001, Drawings.pdf page 1 (2 rows)
[S4] Note: Units furnished with factory controls with BACnet interface.
[S5] Note: Each unit has a duct smoke detector shipped loose for field installation.
[S27] EXHAUST FAN SCHEDULE — M-001, Drawings.pdf page 1 (3 rows)
[S40] Note: Fans furnished with backdraft dampers.
[S31] VRF SCHEDULE — M-002, Drawings.pdf page 3 (3 rows)
[S12] Note: VRF controls by manufacturer with BACnet gateway.
[S32] DUCT HEATER SCHEDULE — M-001, Drawings.pdf page 1 (2 rows)
[S41] CABINET UNIT HEATER SCHEDULE — M-001, Drawings.pdf page 1 (1 row; type rows, no unit tags)
[S2] RTU (rooftop unit): schedule rows 2; QUANTITY column total —; distinct tags 2; plan placements 1 (M-101 1); riser —. Tags: RTU-1 RTU-2.
[S6] EF (exhaust fan): schedule rows 3; QUANTITY column total —; distinct tags 3; plan placements 3 (M-101 3); riser —. Tags: EF-1 EF-2 EF-3.
[S13] DH (duct heater): schedule rows 2; QUANTITY column total —; distinct tags 2; plan placements 0; riser —. Tags: DH-1 DH-2.
[S35] FCU (fan coil unit): schedule rows 1; QUANTITY column total —; distinct tags 4; plan placements 4 (M-102 4); riser —. Tags: FCU-1 FCU-2 FCU-3 FCU-4.
[S43] CO2 (carbon dioxide sensor): 2 in all — E-001 2
[S7] KEYED NOTES 1: MD-1 interlocked with EF-1.
[S8] KEYED NOTES 2: MD-2 interlocked with EF-2.
[S3] KEYED NOTES 3: RTU-1 on the roof above the lobby.
[S37] KEYED NOTES 4: Plumbing fixtures by others.
[S14] GENERAL NOTES 1: fire alarm by division 28.
[S1] The contractor shall provide a new building management system with graphics.
[S38] Integrate the VRF system through its BACnet gateway.
